service: settle one exact newsroom pulse into one publication-owned assignment or one typed refusal
ingress: one externally authored ActivityStreams Create<NewsroomIssueDemand> on stdin, addressed to https://koios.news/activitypub/actor
preconditions: the publication-local executable does not author, schedule, or attribute the pulse
the activity carries its actual trigger actor and exact attenuated capability
the policy admits that actor-capability pair
the demand carries one pulse identifier
the demand carries the exact publication issue policy and its canonical digest
the policy permits exactly one issue per pulse and names its permitted beats, cadence, freshness window, selection mode, and source-refresh authority
postconditions: the exact demand digest returns the first durable settlement on replay
a backlog exceeding the policy's open-assignment capacity is exposed as a typed refusal rather than silently scheduled
an existing open permitted assignment is resumed before a new assignment is formed
at most one assignment is selected from publication-owned demand and admitted source custody
reader demand supplies attention pressure and never factual warrant
an accepted settlement names the assignment, source packet digest, selection basis, and next required service contract
a refused settlement names a typed obstruction without invoking writer or editor inference
prohibitions: no publication, deployment, or static projection
no source admission except through an already accepted source-broker contract
no hidden fallback or retry cascade
no publication-local process may mint a message attributed to an external pulser

providerRequirement.desiredOffice: Clockkeeper of the Cold Red Gate Colony
providerRequirement.admissionState: pending provider deployment, offer, customer acceptance, and exact actor-capability grant

price.accounting: deterministic local execution and Leader-contributed coordination are recorded separately; absence of metering is never projected as zero cost
